children: Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) reported a stronger-than-expected Q2 with $16.1B revenue and 59% Data Center & AI growth, advanced High-NA EUV use on 18A Panther Lake in high-volume production, and signs of a server-CPU supply-driven recovery amid analyst upgrades and Mobileye stake retention.
: Intel (INTC) Q2 revenue $16.1B, +25% YoY. Data Center & AI sales $6.3B, +59%, ~39% of revenue. GAAP gross margin 40.4% (+12.9 pts); GAAP operating margin 11.1%.
: Intel says it and ASML processed 1M+ wafers with High-NA EUV. High-NA used on select 18A Panther Lake layers, matching or beating NXE; Intel began high-volume production on some Panther Lake parts.
: Analyst upgraded Intel (INTC) to Outperform with $120 target, citing turnaround progress, tighter server-CPU supply boosting demand, and Intel’s Terafab work with Tesla relevant to foundry ops.
: Intel (INTC) server CPU shipments projected to rise 15–20% as supply meets demand; high-bandwidth memory price outlook suggests notable downward pressure on related memory component costs.
: Intel Corporation (INTC) retained a majority ownership stake in Mobileye as of 2026, while Mobileye has been listed as an independent public company since 2022.
: A Truth Social post showed an alleged AI-generated image of an Intel (INTC) trade with buy and current prices. No timestamps, brokerage records or filings were provided; INTC rallied intraday.
This is an AI-generated summary and may contain inaccuracies. Please verify any important information with the original sources.
